material_finding: The new physical GRID10 acceptance harness does not yet prove the property its request requires. spawn_node uses subprocess.run sequentially, P1 sets pids=len(packets) rather than observing OS process identifiers or overlap, so a PASS proves ten subprocess invocations but not ten simultaneously live independent Xeno processes sharing one S1 fabric. A second proof gap exists in coordinator admission: coordinator_commit accepts packet.state_epoch <= current epoch and does not compare packet.state_digest with the current snapshot; the GRID10 harness then serially commits packets produced against earlier snapshots while advancing S1. This may be a deliberate stale-evidence policy, but it is not currently distinguished from stale-state acceptance and therefore cannot mint physical GRID10 credit without an explicit policy plus adversarial regression. The 8.80 inbox also accidentally dropped standing Goodman/model-family/Ubuntu-Frank/canonical-promotion guardrails while compressing state; restore them.
required_repairs_before_physical_grid10_: Start ten ordinary Xeno node processes with overlapping lifetimes using Popen or equivalent, not ten sequential subprocess.run invocations.
Capture and receipt ten distinct OS PIDs, process start/stop timestamps, and an overlap/barrier proof showing all ten are alive concurrently while attached read-only to the same isolated S1 database.
Keep ordinary-node S1 write rejection and coordinator lease fencing unchanged.

Define the stale-result contract explicitly: either exact-snapshot admission requiring packet.state_epoch and packet.state_digest to equal the authoritative observation snapshot, or a separately named evidence-rebase protocol that cryptographically preserves original observation identity and proves revalidation before commit.

Add adversarial regression showing a stale packet with an old state_digest cannot silently masquerade as current-state evidence merely because generation matches and packet.state_epoch is <= current epoch.
Only after the repaired source is committed create/use a new pinned FREE_VPS request; the existing fbab596 pin cannot grant physical GRID10 credit even if it returns pass=true.
